summary: B5: backlog with the epics panel and bulk edit
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `fe0e1c8`: Roadmap: B1–B6 done (Board Core, workflows, board with configurable columns, issue view, backlog, search) in DevHub-Plugins
- DevHub-Plugins `2117613`: B2 (workflow editor), B3, B4, B5, B6: the Board plugin's UI — board tabs (board selector, pages, search, Create, board menu), the Board page (columns you add, rename, reorder by drag, merge, delete, statuses per column, WIP limits; cards dragged between columns where the workflow allows and to rank; swimlanes; quick filters and assignee filter), the issue view (side panel and tab: every field editable in place, description in Markdown, sub-tasks / epic issues, links, attachments, time tracking with Log Work, comments, work log, history, sections and actions from other plugins), the Backlog (epics panel, version filter, ranked list with drag, multi-select bulk edit, quick create), Search (query with help and examples, saved filters, results as a list or a board, edit all), project settings tab (general, workflow editor with transition grid, statuses, issue types, priorities, resolutions, custom fields, components, versions, people, link types), New Board / Create Issue / Board Settings / Log Work / Bulk Edit dialogs, the Boards tool window, Settings → Board, actions (Board menu, Find Action, Welcome, Ctrl+Alt+I); extension points for Board.Scrum / Git / Reports / Timeline (pages, issue sections, issue actions, stores); saved filters in Core; a blank creator id gets a real one. Checked in a running DevHub (board, panel, backlog, search, settings, Create) and with Test-Plugins.ps1
